product.problem: Teams need evidence from their codebase before deciding where to change software boundaries.
product.benefit: Understand proposed architecture improvements through code evidence and checks for alternative explanations.
product.input: A public GitHub repository URL or local source folder, with an optional review goal and graph export.
product.output: A 23-section report, 150-aspect coverage matrix, evidence and findings registers, recommendations, verification tasks, migration roadmap and proposed coding-agent work packages.
product.how_it_works: Freezes source, partitions it into bounded tasks, runs OpenCode review inside OpenShell, challenges each aspect, adds evidence-driven follow-ups within budgets, and synthesizes sections before the executive brief.
